lenses.name: Generating capacity
lenses.description: EIA-860M monthly generator inventory: net summer capacity of every generator in service, summed per hex. Zero means no registered plant in the hex.

lenses.name: Main fuel
lenses.description: The fuel with the most operating capacity in each hex (EIA-860M).

lenses.name: Zero-carbon share
lenses.description: Nuclear, hydro, wind, solar and geothermal as a share of operating generating capacity in the hex (storage excluded from both sides). Capacity, not energy produced.
lenses.note: Capacity share, not generation: a solar MW produces far fewer MWh a year than a nuclear MW.

lenses.name: Planned additions
lenses.description: Capacity in EIA-860M's Planned sheet (all planning stages), by hex.
lenses.note: Planned units include early-stage projects that may slip or be cancelled.

lenses.name: Planned retirements
lenses.description: Operating capacity with a planned retirement year in EIA-860M, by hex.

lenses.name: Retired since 2015
lenses.description: Capacity in EIA-860M's Retired sheet with a retirement year of 2015 or later.

lenses.name: Grid operator
lenses.description: Approximate territory of each balancing authority: the operator with the most registered operating capacity in the hex (EIA-860M), with empty hexes taking the nearest operator.

lenses.name: Interconnection queue
lenses.description: Active interconnection-queue requests (generation and storage, all components) by the county of their point of interconnection, spread over the county's hexes by area (LBNL Queued Up 2026 edition, CC BY 4.0).
lenses.note: Most queued capacity is never built: projects withdraw. A queue entry is a request to connect, not a plant. Data through the end of 2025.

lenses.name: Queued technology
lenses.description: The technology with the most active queued capacity in each hex (primary type).
lenses.note: Most queued capacity is never built: projects withdraw. A queue entry is a request to connect, not a plant. Data through the end of 2025.

lenses.name: Data centers
lenses.description: Data center sites tagged in OpenStreetMap (telecom=data_center or building=data_center), counted per hex. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
lenses.note: Crowd-mapped and incomplete; counts sites, not power demand.
